_doc: Event taxonomy for the Chronicle. kind -> doc + default tags. Add a kind here before recording it.

crew_left.doc: actors[0] left the crew. data.reason says why.

credits_changed.doc: Crew funds changed by data.amount for data.reason.

legend_retired.doc: actors[0] retired and became a legend of the shared universe.

trait_evolved.doc: actors[0]'s trait data.trait_id changed from data.from to data.to, caused by data.cause_event_id.

trait_annotated.doc: actors[0]'s trait data.trait_id gained a detail note.
